# Pins the SimChecksum (v8) sequence for PassiveScenario.Build() (an aura owner grants +5 armor to an armored ally each tick; a Neutral on-hit attacker melee-strikes that ally [base + on-hit Magic, both armor-reduced]; a self-regen unit heals via a while-alive Persistent HoT) stepped via StepOnce at ChecksumInterval=1. First golden exercising all three passive drivers AND the v8 EffectiveArmor fold with a non-zero armor value.
